principle_violations.reason: The Order class manages item details, while also handling the payment processing status, which violates SRP. Each class should have a single responsibility only.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate payment processing into a different class/method and manage order details independently.

principle_violations.reason: The payment processors modify the order's status directly, which requires changes for new payment methods and violates OCP. Adding new payment methods requires changes in the existing processor classes.
principle_violations.suggestion: Introduce a method in the Order class for setting payment state and modify the processor to call this method, allowing easier extension for new payment types.

overall_feedback: 2 principle violations found. Please see the details below.
